messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — trying to lock a 60m design review for the new REST + SDK + Console UX flow. Tue 3/30 ideally. Need pre-read + checklist. Who's available? @alex @sam @pri
alex: I can do Tue afternoon 2–4pm PT. Prefer a 60m with 40m review + 20m QA/timebox :+1:
sam: Tue works for me too, prefer earlier (11am PT) — if not available can join async.
pri: I'm OOO Tue morning, 2pm PT works. Can we aim for 40m presentation + 15m focused feedback + 5m action assignment?
ben: +1 to timebox. Also can we include a short 'rollback & compatibility' slot? 5m.
jess: Plan: 40m walkthrough (API surface, SDK ergonomics, console flows) + 15m focused feedback + 5m action owners. Pre-read = design doc + demo GIF + canary playbook. Link: https://redwoodinference.app.link/rd/ux-preread
ciara: Pre-read checklist (quick):
```
- skim design doc (3–5m)
- run demo GIF (30s)
- validate API examples compile (copy/paste)
- flag major perf/security questions as comments
- list rollout blockers / migration steps
```
deploy-bot: Reminder: Please attach the doc to calendar invite or add to meeting thread.
jess: Owners: @alex (API), @pri (SDK), @sam (Console). Reviewers: @ben, @ciara, @maya. RSVP please by EOD Fri.
alex: adding quick diff note: I'll drop a small code snippet for SDK ctor options in the pre-read section.
maya: tentative — need to finish CR before confirming, but will try to attend.
ben: can we get a short live demo env? if not, a recorded screen capture is fine.
jess: good call — will capture a 3min screen recording and attach. Also adding per-route perf numbers in the doc.
ciara: FYI, I flagged two security questions inline. If they remain unresolved, suggest a follow-up security triage (15m max).
sam: If anyone can't make, please leave 3 bullets of feedback in the doc — we'll capture and assign owners.
jess: final ask: if you plan to challenge API shape please add an alternative example in the doc (code block). We'll close on design owners at the meeting.
alex: ack. RSVPed via calendar. thanks.
pri: RSVP done. See you Tue.
maya: RSVP tentative -> will update by Fri.
jess: thanks — I'll send invite + calendar agenda with timebox markers by EOD.
